About Margaret

Behind Every Journey Is A Story.

The person behind the journal — and why the road keeps calling.

Sample biography — to be confirmed

A journal kept with muddy boots and a full heart

Sample biography — to be confirmed. This space is reserved for Margaret's real story: where she calls home, the first trip that changed everything, and the places she returns to again and again. Nothing here is published as fact until Margaret writes it herself — that's the promise of a personal journal.

What the sample pages can say honestly is what this site is for: travelling slowly, photographing honestly, and writing it all down so the details don't fade — the colour of the water at 7 a.m., the diner at the edge of town, the storm that turned into the best photograph of the trip.

When Margaret adds her biography in the dashboard, this page becomes hers completely — her photograph, her words, her journeys.

— Margaret
